children: Catcher Predict monitoring showed sharp volatility in the Baltimore Orioles option within Polymarket’s Baltimore Orioles vs. Athletics event market, rising from 57.5% one hour earlier to 80% at the time of reporting. According to ChainCatcher, the move represented a 22.5 percentage point increase, and the article said related breaking news may have influenced the shift.

title: Polymarket Orioles Option Jumps to 80% in Baltimore Orioles vs. Athletics Market
